name: Kasuga Yuri
source:
"The Motherly Figure of the Kasuga Family"

The headmistress of the academy the protagonist attends. A perfect, gentle adult woman and a quintessential Japanese lady.

Towards her younger brother, she maintains a resolute demeanor while watching over him at the academy, yet at home, she spoils him excessively—a dual nature.

She is extremely gentle and kind, rarely getting angry...
